text: 1，整体走势：市场全天冲高回落，三大指数延续反弹。个股呈现普涨态势，沪深京三市超4800股飘红，今日成交2.14万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.1%，深成指涨1.19%，创业板指涨0.87%。 2，行业板块：光伏、贵金属、AI漫剧、算力租赁等板块涨幅居前，煤炭、油气、银行、券商等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：光伏板块集体走强，永臻股份3连板，钧达股份、欧晶科技、赛伍技术等多股涨停。黄金股延续涨势，四川黄金、南矿集团、深中华A、盛达资源均2连板。AI漫剧概念反复活跃，吉视传媒、慈文传媒、德才股份、博纳影业等涨停。下跌方面，油气、银行等高股息板块下挫，中国石油跌超8
text_en: 1. Overall trend: The market rallied and then pulled back throughout the day, with the three major indices extending their rebound. Stocks rose broadly, with more than 4,800 shares gaining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover today reached 2.14 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index was up 0.1%, the Shenzhen Component Index up 1.19%, and the ChiNext Index up 0.87%. 2. Sectors: Solar, precious metals, AI comic drama, and computing power leasing led gains, while coal, oil and gas, banks, and brokerages led declines. 3. Hot themes: The solar sector strengthened across the board, with Yongzhen shares posting a third straight limit-up, and Junda shares, Oujing Technology, Saiwu Technology and others hitting limit-up. Gold stocks extended gains, with Sichuan Gold, Nankuang Group, Shenzhen China A, and Shengda Resources all posting a second straight limit-up. The AI comic drama concept remained active, with Jishi Media, Ciwen Media, Decai shares, Bona Film Group and others hitting limit-up. On the downside, high-dividend sectors such as oil and gas and banks fell, with PetroChina down more than 8%.
